t: Bring ten pieces of sateen cloth.

Whenever they talk about the Aoidos, they always bring up the numerous compatriots who joined the League. It’s true that few of us joined the Empire, but they exist, and I’m proof of that!

 It doesn’t matter how many soldiers the League gets. What matters is what the Empire has - and it has Lucia, the best seamstress in the world. And I might not be a mage, but I do have skills.

 My magic does not summon thunder and lightnings, but enchanting fabrics, making them tougher than steel? That I can do.

I'll make magic banners for your guild as soon as you bring me the required materials. I need enchanted sateen for first Generation banners. Bring it to me, and I'll get to work. Let your guild leaders decide who should bear it.
Your guild can now use Generation 1 Banners! They are powerful artifacts that can turn the tide of battle.
Bring ten pieces of satin cloth.

Banner magic is ancient. I heard you’ve been to Kirah and taken part in the ritual of creating a Standard? Or perhaps you’ve hoisted a War Banner at some point? Or performed feats during the May Holidays under a Victorious Banner?

Then you know what I’m talking about! It’s all part of the craft that creates these rare artifacts, and I’ve mastered it to perfection. But to make a banner like this, I need a special material.

To transform your old banners into Generation 2 Banners, I need something better than sateen. I need enchanted satin! Bring it to me, and I'll provide your guild with new banners. Let your leaders decide who will be worthy of bearing them!
Your guild can now use Generation 2 Banners! I hope they will help you!
Bring ten pieces of brocade cloth.

What can be worse than losing your own banner? You, a soldier of the Empire, should understand that. Banner is part of a combat unit! I heard a story about one General Sidorov who lost their regimental standard during the battle of Umoir. Poor bastard... He never recovered from it. He couldn’t handle the shame and quietly wasted away, turning into an undead!

But you’re not like that, are you? So make sure to keep the banner safe! To transform your old banners into Generation 3 Banners, I need a proper material. Only the finest brocade will do. Get it for me and come back.

And remember: the leaders of your guild must decide who will bear them.
Your guild can now use Generation 3 Banners! Oh, this is a masterpiece. Just imagine it flying high!
Bring ten pieces of sateen cloth.

To be honest, this is not a simple order. Still, you’ve come to the right place. I’m known not just as a seamstress, but also a sorceress – of a kind, I guess.

My magic does not summon thunder and lightnings, but enchanting fabrics, making them tougher than steel? That I can do.

I'll make magic banners for your guild as soon as you bring me the required materials. I need enchanted sateen for first Generation banners. Bring it to me, and I'll get to work. Let your guild leaders decide who should bear it.
Your guild can now use Generation 1 Banners! They are powerful artifacts that can turn the tide of battle.
Bring ten pieces of satin cloth.

Banner magic is ancient. I heard you’ve been to Kirah and taken part in the ritual of creating a Standard? Or perhaps you’ve hoisted a War Banner at some point? Or performed feats during the May Holidays under a Victorious Banner?

Then you know what I’m talking about! It’s all part of the craft that creates these rare artifacts, and I’ve mastered it to perfection. But to make a banner like this, I need a special material.

To transform your old banners into Generation 2 Banners, I need something better than sateen. I need enchanted satin! Bring it to me, and I'll provide your guild with new banners. Let your leaders decide who will be worthy of bearing them!
Your guild can now use Generation 2 Banners! I hope they will help you!
Bring ten pieces of brocade cloth.

What can be worse than losing your own banner? You’ll become a laughingstock, and no one will ever take you seriously.

I heard a story about one General Sidorov who lost their regimental standard during the battle of Umoir. Poor bastard... He never recovered from it. He couldn’t handle the shame and quietly wasted away, turning into an undead!

But you’re not like that, are you? So make sure to keep the banner safe! To transform your old banners into Generation 3 Banners, I need a proper material. Only the finest brocade will do. Get it for me and come back.

And remember: the leaders of your guild must decide who will bear them.
Your guild can now use Generation 3 Banners! Oh, this is a masterpiece. Just imagine it flying high!

I have discovered an interesting phenomenon. Your allods are held together by a spell powered by the willpower of the Great mages and dragon blood. Or meteorite iron. I've always been curious whether these materials are the only ones with that sort of properties. As expected, your world is much bigger than you can imagine. I've looked for new ways of sustaining life on allods, but found... a way to combat darkness.

Red meteorite is one of the most rare resources in your world, and I found only crumbs of it. That's all that's left. But I summoned you not to crush your hopes but to raise them. The Architects used a special material called Matter of Creation – I can use it to recreate this noble mineral.

If we can get enough of it, I will be able to create a continent where you can build a stronghold to defend against the forces of darkness. The special properties of this material will protect you.

However... I've been here for a while, so I know there's darkness in each of you. You will face competition. The meteorite only protects against the forces of darkness, not other people... Prepare to battle other guilds, because everyone wants to survive.
Soon you will have enough material, and we will start constructing the mainland.

Excellent. A difficult path lies ahead, but we can handle it. And finally: I found this strange creature while I was traveling the world. It’s not aggressive at all. I’m sure you can raise it, and it will be protecting your new home. You will need all the help you can get. So why not use it?
Earn Sparks from the Kingdom of Elements and exchange them for a Vial with Sealed Souls.

Today we're going to try something unusual. An expedition in the Kingdom of Elements discovered a few suitable sparks. Go there and help our colleagues. Don't forget to take Sparks as payment, because our new pet is very hungry. You don't want it to eat anyone useful, do you?
That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.
Earn Sparks from the Kingdom of Elements and exchange them for a Vial with Sealed Souls.

I believe we’ve found a new source of Sparks. The expedition in the Kingdom of Elements managed to put something together. They’ll give us these Sparks, but they’ll need something in return. A favor for a favor. So go there and find out what you can do to help, then come back with the Sparks.
That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.
Earn Sparks from Heroic Adventures and exchange them for a Vial with Sealed Souls.
Astral keeps you fed, right? Sparks of the most powerful monsters are perfect for our Keeper. It won’t be easy, but you can do it, I’m sure.
That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.
Earn Sparks from Heroic Adventures and exchange them for a Vial with Sealed Souls.

Astral is an interesting place. People have brought some strange things from the Astral. I believe you can find anything you want over there. But right now we need Sparks for our Keeper. Get them and come back.
That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.
Earn Sparks from raid adventures and exchange them for a Vial with Sealed Souls.
Observatory is a good source of juicy Soul Sparks. You already know what I’m asking, right? Gather your friends and go to the Observatory. Bring me as many sparks as you can.
That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.
Earn Sparks from raid adventures and exchange them for a Vial with Sealed Souls.
With great deeds come great rewards, right? You probably already know what this is about. Yes, it’s time to go to the Observatory. Gather your friends and get me some Sparks!
That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.
Exchange the feed for a Vial with Sealed Souls.

You know what’s the worst thing in the world? Greed! I managed to find an interesting supplier who’s willing to sell us a large batch of Sparks. But this greedy bastard wants a few tons of feed in return! He’s breeding horses or something. Get me 300 bags of feed and I’ll get us a Vial with Sealed Souls.
That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.
Exchange the feed for a Vial with Sealed Souls.

Nothing is free. Same goes for Sparks. I found someone who can help us with those. In return he wants feed. A lot of feed. They say he breeds horses or something. Get me 300 bags of feed and I’ll get us a Vial with Sealed Souls!
That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.
Purchase a Crystal Soul Shard at the Boutique.

It's Goblin Banker, isn't it?

Of course that scoundrel would have a Spark or two in his stash. And not just any Sparks... Crystal Soul - if we want our Keeper to become truly powerful, we need it. So get it!
Purchase a Crystal Soul Shard at the Boutique.

That Goblin Banker, one of the so-called Tycoons that make their living by ripping off common folk!

Of course that scoundrel would have a Spark or two in his stash. And not just any Spark... but a very rare Crystal Soul. If we want our Keeper to become truly powerful, we need it. So get it!
That’s not much. I hope someone brings another potion or two.
Get all Ethereal Wood from Al Rihat.

Ethereal Wood from Al Rihat is one of the most valuable resources in Sarnaut! And we really need it. But... most of it was cut some time ago, and its last reserves are kept in the Patriarch’s residence. We can probably come to an arrangement, right? They probably need help.
Get all Ethereal Wood from Al Rihat.

Al Rihat. A nasty place full of elves and monsters. All that riff-raff. The order from the capital is simple: you need to go to Al Rihat and provide aid to the enemy of the Empire - the elves. In exchange, you’ll receive Ethereal Wood that you’ll bring to me. Go now!
Great, you fulfilled the order. You’re free to go.
Get a Worker Contract by completing quests related to battles.

The world is so bloodthirsty! The blood shedding business is thriving! The best crafters work in gladiator arenas because it’s more profitable! How awful... Why do people enjoy looking at gladiators in skintight leather tunics, with beautiful flowing hair... Hah. I get it. That’s why!

But let’s get back to business. They offered us a good deal in the capital: defeat the local gladiators, and we’ll be able to use their workers for a time. They get a show, and we get manpower. Muscular... handsome manpower. Ahem, sorry.
Get a Worker Contract by completing quests related to battles.

Fighters, gladiators are a fertile field for a professional soldier of the Empire, but comparing the military power of the Empire under Yasker's leadership and our Stronghold would be odd!

Gladiators from the capital are ready to offer their best fighters in exchange for a Worker Contract for their workers. We need all hands on deck, so we accept their terms! Order: go to the capital and show them what you've learned in the Imperial army!
Great, you fulfilled the order. You’re free to go.

Peaceful place, they said. Right! Is there a truly empty allod anywhere in the Astral?! There’s an orc camp right under our walls! A Gill and Waterfolk lair down the river. People go missing!
 I’m asking you - please grab a few tough guys and deal with that vermin!

And I’m going to contact the local mercenaries so they’ll start patrolling the area once you secure it.

We’re short of resources for our combat mechanisms. Oil delivery is always late. I already submitted a few complaints to the capital, but we can’t wait until they deal with it! The mechanisms are starting to fail, which means the quality of my work suffers!

We’ll look for other methods... Primitive methods. Gibberlings use animal fat as grease for their weapons and boats. Wormfaces to the southwest store old fat in containers and no longer use it. It doesn’t matter which one you’ll go after. Just get it for me!

I’ll heat-treat it and use it as oil for our machines.
Great, you fulfilled the order. You’re free to go.

Crystal chips... They are used for processing various materials required for the construction of our fortress.

I understand their value and know that we both need them, but... perhaps you can get some for me? It should really help us with granite and metal cutting.

Any military action always goes hand in hand with corruption. The bigger the army, the more complex it is to run it. Bureaucracy in the capital won't let us get the Crystal Chips required for the construction of our fortress.

Use any means necessary but get it for me! We can't just sit and wait for the capital to help us.

I wrote to Yasker already, so we'll await mass executions.
Great, you fulfilled the order. You’re free to go.
Purchase a Shred of Contract for Construction Golems at the Boutique

Nasty! Nasty! Disgusting type! Oh, I'm not talking about you. I mean the Goblin Banker, the nastiest goblin in existence!

He heard about our enterprise and offered his services. Nasty! Nasty services!

He's willing to sell us a few construction golems, and each is worth ten men! Ten men, you hear? Nasty, nasty type!

Well, he's nasty because he's asking a lot... Quite a lot... Nasty...
Purchase a Contract for Construction Golems at the Boutique

The greatness of the Empire is impressive but not impressive enough! Endless riches are in the hands of other races. They are headed by the Goblin Banker. This individual refuses to work for the good of the Empire. He’s only interested in money. One day we’ll make him answer for all the problems he’s causing us, but now... we’ll have to play by his rules.

Soldier, bring me a Contract for Construction Golems - his golems are better than our machines, so they’ll build our stronghold faster. Get going!
Great, you fulfilled the order. You’re free to go.
Deliver the Contribution to the Stronghold currency to the Stronghold's supplier

Earn special currency by turning in Guild quest items:

Contract for Ethereal Wood Delivery: 15 pcs.

Contract for Land Work: 12 pcs.

Ounce of Animal Fat: 2 pcs.

1 Crystal Chip.

Shred of Contract for Construction Golems: 1 pc.

Sparks of the Kingdom of Elements: 3 pcs.

Sparks of Heroic Adventures: 4 pcs.

Sparks of Raid Adventures: 3 pcs.

Mount Feed: 1 pc.

Crystal Soul Shard: 1 pc.

A Pair of Small Monster Heads: 1 pc.

Large Monster Head: 2 pcs.

Dangerous Monster Head: 20 pcs.

June Reactor: 100 pcs.

Participate in defeating a Stronghold Golem Sentry: 150 pcs.
Well done. The Guild will never forget your help.
You must travel to Battle Curator Maximus Cornell in Yasker's Tower.

There's a letter for you. It says "read aloud to the recipient" on the envelope. So here we go:

, my dear friend! I am Maximus Cornell, and it is my pleasure to inform you that I am looking for brave warriors who would fight against mighty Keepers, the guardians of Strongholds. If you are interested, I will be waiting in Yasker’s Tower in Nezebgrad!
I'm glad you answered my call! Let me give you this envelope with invitations to battle. I hope you achieve great results in the Coliseum!
Travel to Battle Curator Maximus Cornell in Aidenus' Tower.

There's a letter for you. It says "read aloud to the recipient" on the envelope. So here we go:

, my dear friend! I am Maximus Cornell, and it is my pleasure to inform you that I am looking for brave warriors who would fight against mighty Keepers, the guardians of Strongholds. If you are interested, I will be waiting in Aidenus' Tower in Novograd!
I'm glad you answered my call! Let me give you this envelope with invitations to battle. I hope you achieve great results in the Coliseum!

Be careful with your mail! Don't miss important letters.
Here, take it. I have plenty of these.
Here you are! May you find the Revelation!... If it actually exists at all, that is.

The postal service is one of civilization's greatest achievements. Thanks to a network of portals and hardworking postal workers, letters and packages arrive at their destinations without delay!
Postal workers can be found throughout all of the Allods. Each one is trained to provide the same quality of service and meet all of your mailing needs! You can send letters and packages to your friends and they will be delivered for a small fee. You can also check your mail and see if someone sent something to you.
Remember that letters and packages are stored for no longer than thirty days. You should check your mailbox from time to time so you don't lose important or valuable mail. Thank you for using the postal service and have a nice day!
Talk to Goblin Banker at the Boutique to be able to use mail from any point of Sarnaut.
Oh yes, the letter, written on birch bark instead of paper. What's wrong with it?
Have you lost it? No problem, Vseslav was wise enough to have sent several copies. Here's one.

Ah!
Another letter that appeared from nowhere! I remember I saw it before!

Be careful with your mail! Don't miss important letters.
Here, take it. I have plenty of these.
Get the envelope with an invitation to the Keeper Coliseum

Battles take place daily. But the number of invitations is limited.

I'll give you an envelope with three invitations to each league. If a suitable Keeper is available, of course. In the future, you will automatically receive such invitations from me every week.

Your invitations are spent only if you defeat a Keeper, not per attempt. Well, a good show earns me money, so I wouldn't want you to die too quickly, yes?

Even if all your invitations are gone, you are welcome to assist those who still have them.
Obtain at least 200 Small Monster Heads.

Greetings, soldier! I have a job for you.

We received order 1137 from the capital:

The twelfth regiment reports that enemy forces have been spotted in the area and they must be eliminated. Southwest: aborigines detected. Order 1137 calls for a complete annihilation of the supposed enemy and subsequent capture of the territory.

Southeast: powerful psi-subunits detected. Wormfaces pose a serious threat that can disrupt the work of the construction forces at our base. They must be eliminated.

Got it? Go!
Order 1137 successfully fulfilled! We’ll inform the capital of your results. Keep it up!

How is it going, soldier? Listen up.

Order 5391 is as follows:

The twelfth regiment sighted special subunits in the enemy army. Powerful psionic and magic units that pose a serious threat to our forces. Request for Yasker Hawks' immediate assistance has been denied. Tactical center advises the use of means at hand.

Enemy's location: Southeast - Wormfaces.

Enemy's location: Southwest - Gibberlings.

Objective: locate and eliminate the most dangerous forces of the enemy. Take no prisoners.

Go now! You have your orders!

Order 5391 successfully fulfilled! We'll inform the capital of your results.

Glory to Yasker! Glory to the Empire!

At ease, soldier!

What do we know about the Wormfaces? These creatures maintain constant telepathic contact, forming a council of a kind which they call Superintelligence. This Superintelligence allows them to coordinate attacks and act with great efficiency.

Our scouts also report that Gibberling healers use cold magic! They summon elementals in hopes that they will protect their village. Hah! That's not going to happen.

This is order 5631: eliminate Wormface Psionicists to disrupt any connection between them. That's your first task. Possible location: Southeast sector.

Get rid of these icy creatures - that's the second one. This allod will belong to the Empire, and no one can stop us! Possible location: Southwest sector.

You have your orders!
Order 5631 successfully fulfilled! We’ll inform the capital of your results. Thank you for your service!

Amateurs! Idiots! The quantum system will be exhausted before the turbulence process is complete and the decay period starts. Do they understand that in the capital? It's obvious! You're a hero of the Empire. You should understand these things!

But an order is an order, right? But surely there are people capable of something other than following orders, so what do they need me for?

I detected high energy emission underground, in the Wormfaces' territory. I believe they have a functional golem somewhere in the catacombs. Go there and deal with the thing. Just don't damage the reactor! I need it.

The catacombs are in the southeast sector.
Fantastic! The case is a bit dented, and the core looks like the whole base is going to blow up, but I’ll think of something... I don’t know, I’ll cover it.
Listen to the Political Commissar's speech.

The Empire needs you, soldier! Think what Yasker would say if he saw you falter! The Empire is an Idea! And we follow it.

Look around you! What do you see, soldier? Just snow and ice? No, a loyal citizen of the Empire must see new opportunities and lands for the expansion of the great State!

Break free of your doubts! You decide the fates of thousands of Imperial citizens, and Yasker himself is watching us! For victory! Hurray!
I see that gleam in your eyes! I know you won’t flinch when the time comes!
Listen to the cleric's farewell speech.

Everyone needs help on occasion. It’s nothing to be ashamed of. Accept the light. My duty is to absolve you of your sins. A great war is coming. You should get cleansed before starting on that bloody but necessary path.
My duty is fulfilled, the light is now protecting you!
Obtain at least 200 small monster heads.

The smaller the monster, the more trouble it is. It’s an old wisdom, but it’s still true.

Yesterday the Waterfolk tried to steal our cow, but once they realized they weren’t strong enough, they just slaughtered it!

A week ago, goblins set our barn on fire. How long must we suffer this?! The guard only protects us against serious threats. And the little things are ours to deal with, they say. Please... You and your guild are famous around here, so please help the old man out. We did nothing to deserve this.

They say the orcs’ camp is in the Scarlet Forest in the east, and the Waterfolk’s lair is behind the mountains, to the east of the Wild Orcs' Camp
Accept my gratitude! My children will sleep peacefully today.

We need blades by Wednesday, they said. We need armor by Tuesday, they said. I’m not a sorceress! I’m a blacksmith! I can’t conjure armor and weapons out of thin air!

Bloody orcs are out hunting. Ore is mined in the mountains, to the east from here, and these animals want to get their hands on some good iron.

But we both know what I’m asking, right? Oh, no. I’m asking you not to get the iron back, but to stick my swords up their... A lady shouldn’t really speak like that.

They say the orcs’ camp is in the Scarlet Forest in the east, and the Waterfolk’s lair is behind the mountains, to the east of the Wild Orcs' Camp
Orcs and Gills are dead? What a relief. I’ll handle the delivery.

The locals say they saw huge creatures near the fortress. There's an orcs' camp in the north, so that must have been mountain trolls. They say orcs often use them as siege weapons.

But what's worse, the Waterfolk are also employing something really big, and I overlooked that somehow. Their camp is in the east.

Please find that "something" before it attacks our fortress! And deal with the trolls while you're at it. We don't want to get showered with rocks at night, do we?

Amazing...

If they decided to storm us... we’d be in big trouble. It’s great you’ve dealt with them already.

Do you hear it? Listen... That's from underground. The ground is shaking every couple of hours. As though there's something living down there. And you know what? There probably is.

I saw a trail in the east that lead to the old ruins. I'd swear there was an underground tunnel, and the ruins looked a lot like a June temple.

June Golems are an inexhaustible source of energy for our mechanisms. If my guesses are correct, we must find and destroy the golem without damaging the energy reactor! It must be kept intact. It would greatly help our constructors, and I'd be able to sleep at night.
So big! I’m sure it was a hard fight. Is everyone alright?

The best warriors are honored by their whole Branch! When the sun rolls down behind the horizon, and the world is shrouded in the sweet smells of the night, Pridens light up their ritual fires which signify the start of the final combats.

The best of the best enter the ring! Fighting each other is an honor for all of them. This is the combat of the mightiest. The combat of equals!

You are one of them now. Go, kylys, and bring us victory!
May the lucky Moon shine upon you, kylys!

Here you are! The smell of victory and blood surrounds you - the smell of triumph! Today you’re the hero of your tribe! I mean, the League, eysh!

Rejoice in your victory, fill your cup with sweet wine, and taste the most delicious foods! You have deserved it, kylys.

Can you feel that smell, kylys? The smell of freshly mowed grass, of the northern wind - and sword steel! The Season of Blood is coming - our ancient Priden tournament. The best warriors of all Branches gather and practice their martial skills. Because practice is crucial however strong you are!

Now we are bringing the Season of Blood to the rest of Sarnaut, eysh! Everyone who thinks themself to be a great warrior should learn to fight side by side with their allies!

Are you ready to learn the lesson of the Season of Blood, zoor?
Your allies are the key to your victory, kylys!

Yes! Your allies are the key to your victory, kylys!

I hope your training was helpful. Glorious and terrible combats await you.
Defeat a powerful enemy on an Astral Allod of the actual sector.
Use Tools to convert 10 Enchanted Shards or measures of Matter of the actual sector.
Transform equipment on the Anvil of Artifacts.
Kill an enemy character in the Kingdom of Elements.
Every hero who has Astral Keys receives one Box with Loot as a reward on a daily basis. To stop receiving these quests, speak with the Relic Master at the Astral Academy.

A daily single-player quest from the Relic Master. You can abandon it once a day in order to take another one.

This quest will be completed automatically once you complete all the requirements.

Talk to the Relic Master in the Astral Academy to stop receiving these daily quests.

Пришло время обратить внимание на обычные Артефакты, творения Великих Магов, способные даровать тебе дополнительные особенности.

Нам доступны их астральные копии, постепенно теряющие свою силу слепки с изначального прототипа.

Артефакты делятся на артефакты Героев и артефакты Убийц. Первые проявляют свою силу в приключениях, сражениях с разными чудовищами в открытом мире. Вторые окажут тебе помощь с сражении с такими же, как и ты, героями.

Сейчас ты сможешь получить первый из артефактов Героев, купив его у Эрфара Краснобая за Сигнеты Иркаллы, которые можно получить выполняя его задания.
Great, you have your first Artifact. Remember: they last a limited time and need to be replaced at some point.
Good job, now you know where to get Artifacts...

Glad to see you.

I'm a Relic Master. There are only two of us in Sarnaut.

As soon as the first Relic of the ancient heroes was discovered, it became clear that such artifacts can be transformed, and the demand for my crafting skills was increased. Everyone needs a craftsman who has a knack for all these swords and armor. I used to be a blacksmith, you know... But under the guidance of the Great Yasker I was reforged, so to say...

Well, what would you like to know about my job?

The Artifact Converter allows you to exchange artifacts of the same level. The converter consumes Mysterious Particles. Their quantity depend on the artifact level.

I can sell you Mysterious Particles - 10 at a time and no more than 200 particles per week. The initial price of 10 particles is {value}. After every 50 particles the price will increase, but at the start of the next week the price will be back to its original level. Let me know if you want to buy particles. If you have enough money, I will sell them to you.

Every day you will be given special tasks that will help you create items for upgrading equipment.

These tasks will not require you to do anything you haven't already done. Just normal heroic activities - defeat these and save these... But don't worry: there are mundane tasks, too. Like converting Enchanted Shards and Matter using Tools, for example. Practice makes perfect!

Completing these tasks will earn you Enchanted Matter, Amalgam, and Gold.

Once a day, you can turn down a task to get another. If you turn down two tasks, you'll have to wait until the next day.

To stop receiving these daily tasks, talk to me.
Alright! If you want me to start giving these quests again, just tell me!

Universal Tools are of the same quality as crafted tools. But they are easier to get - the Boutique is always at hand, after all. And they are a pleasure to work with.

Using them to convert equipment parts will provide the largest amounts of materials. Like any other tools, they can be used to convert resources: raw materials can be turned into dust.

Here you go. These tools are much better than common crafted ones. Although they are not as easy to get. Tensess knows crafting them would take less time.

Using them to convert equipment parts will provide the largest amounts of materials. Like any other tools, they can be used to convert resources: raw materials can be turned into dust.
Great, you have your first Artifact. Remember: they last a limited time and need to be replaced at some point.
Good job, now you know where to get Artifacts...

Драконы – обладают великой силой, с этим никто не будет спорить. Долгие века на них вели охоту, сначала джуны, а затем и Великие Маги. Существовал целый Орден охотников на драконов, представителем которого был, возможно тебе знакомый, укротитель Арат.

Они хотели похитить силы драконов… и часто им это удавалось. Так были созданы могущественные артефакты, известные как драконьи реликвии.

Теперь эти силы нужно получить и тебе.

Самый простой способ – покупка у Эрфара Краснобая за Сигнеты Иркаллы, которые можно получить выполняя его задания.

Добудь одну из таких Драконьих реликвий и твоё обучение будет завершено.

Great, this is a first and very important step.

Thanks to heroes and explorers, new Draconic Aspect items are constantly being discovered, so don't forget to change your outdated equipment to new one.
Good job, now you know where to get Draconic Aspect items.

Great, this is a first and very important step.

Thanks to heroes and explorers, new Draconic Aspect items are constantly being discovered, so don't forget to change your outdated equipment to new one.
Good job, now you know where to get Draconic Aspect items.
The process of upgrading equipment is quite simple. But keep in mind that nothing in life comes easy. To get really good equipment, you have to work for it.
Easy, right? Now that you know this, the task of getting the desired equipment won't seem as daunting.
Learn to use Hero's Insignias to upgrade your equipment.

It's one thing to craft equipment. Another is to bring it to perfection. We all have development potential, and so does your equipment.

It's simple - the stats of your equipment can be increased with the help of Hero's Insignias. If you carefully examine your equipment, you will notice that each item has its own percentage of effectiveness. 100% is great, but the maximum that can be reached is 115%. To reach the desired percentage, you need to find the corresponding Hero's Insignia.

You're wondering how to get those, right? The most obvious but not the easiest way is to go on adventures to the astral allods of increased difficulty. They can be unlocked using a Hero's Compass. Not everyone can handle this kind of danger.

There's another alternative: accumulating the required amount of material and creating the Hero's Insignia on the anvil. How? Listen carefully:

To craft a Hero’s Insignia, you need Enchanted Dust and Amalgam. Enchanted Dust can be obtained by converting Enchanted Matter using tools. It can be obtained by helping in adventures on astral allods and by completing Distortions.

Amalgam can be acquired by converting Drops of Amalgam that are earned in Skirmishes, Tka-Rik's Cave, or obtained by completing special alchemical quests. Once you have all the components, use the Anvil of Artifacts. You will be able to create the insignia in the appropriate section. To upgrade a piece of equipment, use a Hero's Insignia on the item.

Let's try and create a Hero's Insignia.

Gods' Legacy is a powerful item that could be created after other worlds were discovered - when it became clear that they were inhabited by numerous gods. Gods' Legacy is a concentration of their power that's scattered throughout the worlds. It gives you a small glimpse of their might.

If you create this artifact, you will gain great power! It's an opportunity you can't pass up.

Ah, youngsters... We have to explain everything to you! Back in the day, we learned it all by trial and error. And we're still alive and kicking, as you can see. All limbs are accounted for. Ah, well...
Great, now you have gods' power in your hands. Use it wisely.

Gods' Legacy can become even more powerful!

You can increase the level of the artifact using the same Elixirs and Gifts of Dreams that used to create Gift of the First - the components that can improve Gods' Legacy. The higher the artifact's level, the more materials you will need.

To increase the level from 1 to 10, you will need 1 Gift of the First.

To increase the level from 10 to 20, you will need 2 Gifts of the First.

To increase the level from 20 to 30, you will need 3 Gifts of the First.

To increase the level from 30 to 40, you will need 4 Gifts of the First.

To increase the level from 40 to 100, you will need 5 Gifts of the First.

See? It's simple. Just takes some time.

Ah, youngsters... We have to explain everything to you! Back in the day, we learned it all by trial and error. And we're still alive and kicking, as you can see. All limbs are accounted for. Ah, well...
See? The artifact has become even more powerful. You can continue to improve it!
Obtain five units of Matter of Creation

This is where our work begins.

Every day I can process only five crystals, because I’m no longer connected to the Architect network and I’m not as strong as they are.

Bring me Matter of Creation, and I’ll turn it into a red meteorite for you.

Matter of Creation is an extremely rare ingredient, but it can be found in various parts of Sarnaut. Follow events around the world. If someone insignificant gets their hands on the Matter, I advise you to take it from them for the sake of the common good. We need it more.

We’ll need 105 units of meteorite - then we’ll be able to create your Stronghold.

Здравствуй, ! Давненько мы с тобой не виделись. Хоть и говорила я, чтоб ты ко мне больше не заглядывала, что, если снова явишься сюда, то приём уже другой будет, всё-таки призываю я тебя по нужде.

Дело в том, что изменилось что-то в самой земле, за которой следить я поставлена. Мало того, что разбит наш мир, расколот на части, аллодами называемые, так ещё и ныне с иных звёзд до нас свет долетает, смуту и волнения приносит.

Вот и мои питомцы, малахитовые ящерки, как не свои в последние времена. Разбрелись, разошлись по всему миру, а тропы у них свои, тайные.

Боюсь в беду попадут малышки, нужно их поймать. В награду одарю тебя каменьями драгоценными, не пожалею малахитов. Прибудь как можно скорее.
Arrive at Tatiana Dubinskaya's pet exhibition.
The letter asks you to come to Eljune Bazaar on Eljune and find Tatiana Dubinskaya.
Catching pets is an extremely interesting activity.
You will be able to tame pets in all corners of the endless Sarnaut.
See who wins the bet with Nihaz
Let's see who wins the bet, shall we?

Haha, isn't my daughter clever?

I hope you understand the reason behind all this.

Anyway, I think you've found everything you were looking for. And I'm going to give you a consolation prize, of course.

You can go now. It's time for me to return to my case. In the tavern.
Find a way to take Ath-Zak's Spark from Nihaz

Ugh, I finally got myself to you. Wasn't it a brilliant idea to mail myself in a letter? It's better than having to find a ride. Or going on foot! I'm not a horse, you know.

What are you staring at? Do you think I was all comfy? Think again.

Alright, , listen up. I don't have all day. You're a hero, right?

I know you are. Well, and I am not!

There's something that's been tormenting me, I can't stand it anymore. My friend's Spark is in the hands of this bastard! You get special treatment from Nihaz. Everybody knows that, even the ghosts. I'm telling you, if you show up and ask for Zak's Spark, he's going to give it to you right away. Well, maybe not right away... So, anyway. We'll see.

If you don't do what I say, I'll show up every night and howl over your bed while you sleep.

What are you waiting for? Kingdom come?
Well, the rules are set, let's begin.

Tka-Rik, or Tka-a-Lithan Ric-ti-a-Nic, the greatest June mage, first of the Great Mages...

His Revelation was interesting, wasn't it? How did you like learning the mysteries of the world? Oh, I put a lot of effort into staging the Performance to open your eyes to Sarn's lies.

The Great Mage found his death in his cave. He fell to Sarn's demons' hands on the night that you refer to as the Night of Astral Portals. It's only the end of his story. How did it begin?

Let's remember the dragons. The guards of Sarn's prison, watching him on my order. Dragons are obedient. The time has no power over them. They were fulfilling their duty for millions of years. But everything changed when a small ship carrying the Absolute Order got in trouble in the middle of nowhere.

The Ship is falling on Sarnaut. It explodes in a dazzling flash somewhere high. Several dragons fall down, killed by shrapnel. The prison is breached. The prisoner makes a move.

He has a crafty plan, and it takes dragons a while to understand what's going on. Everything becomes clear when people come to this world. Dragons begin their war... the war to destroy all Sarn's creations.

Do you want to know what happened next? Retrace the footsteps of the ancient war. Explore Asee-Teph. Start from the place where there were rivers of blood. This is where you can find a thread to pull and unravel the mystery.

Huh, I hope, you realize now that Junes' fate was their own fault?

Their success depended on the dragon blood, the borrowed force that failed to help them against the Curse of their own Creator.

The Great Mage Tka-Rik? What a whiner. After everything that happened to the Junes, he put the blame on himself, felt remorse, and condemned himself to centuries of imprisonment under Gipat mountains. But his heritage survived. The elves have awakened to find a lot of Junes' artifacts, including those of blood magic. It turned up badly. Over time, the hit upon the idea of trying the dragon blood.

This is how they got their own Great Mages, who trained Skrakan, who trained the others, and finally, you all nearly destroyed the world by shattering it to pieces.

Say thanks for all this to Tka-Rik and his thirst for revenge.

Oh, Eljune...

Do you remember the adorable ruins? That's all that was left of the great June civilization. And they were smarter than us. It was hard enough for you to kill two dragons, but Junes defeated eight Great Dragons and a few smaller ones. Junes are gone now. Do you think someone would run around the ruins of your cities, wondering what happened to you?

Let's get to the point. A very curious adventure seeker was here, very curious about the Junes' death. She was logging her findings. Somebody stole her log, torn it apart, and scattered the pages all over Eljune. Find her notes and take her path, and you could find Luja-Gialla's Spark!

What to start with? Well, I can tell you that whoever stole her log, got what they deserved! Balancing between the League and Imperial troops is dangerous. He's food to ravens now.

You have found Luja-Gialla's Spark! Did you like the story? A real tragedy, isn't it?

Sarn created a number of races, trying to make ideal terminators. It was fun to ruin his plans! All it took was telling the Junes what they will face after the last dragon's death! Poor Sarn! He never expected them to renounce their vows! He cursed them in anger, and it was a very strong Curse. He regretted it later, of course, but I didn't let him interfere.

This is a truly beautiful story. Some of them gave up their essence and stop being Junes. Others flee.

Tka-Rik really managed to hold off the Curse during that battle. He also cast the relocation spell that saved the survivors from the Jakala Ruins. They were out of his sight for years.

The runaways were hiding from the Curse, weakened by the battle, for centuries. From time to time it picked up their trail, killed some of them... but others managed to flee. Yes, Luja-Gialla and Ath-Zak are their descendants.

Do you wish to know how Tka-Rik came to be the Great Mage and the Bane of the Fire Dragons? That's a whole different story.
Find Ath-Zak's spark on Coba Plateau.

The time has come for our final game in these lands.

If you only knew how hard it is to stage Performances for you! Actors never stick to the script, prop master spoil the props...

I had to put in a lot of effort to stage a small Performance for someone whose Spark you're going to be looking for. Starting a rumor on Suslanger that there are meteorites in the Futile Lands... Whispering to Kanian degraded descendants on Gipat that the Chosen One appears in the old ruins, according to an old legend... And finally, setting the weakened Curse after the last Junes...

Ath-Zak's Spark wasn't all that valuable for me after all. A crafty thief once stole it. I won't tell you when it happened or who he was, but here's a generous hint. This is a fragment of his letter, when he was going to Coba Plateau...

Hahaha! You really thought I was hiding the Sparks? Or giving them to someone else? Come on now, it isn't our first game. How could you be so naive?

If I simply wanted to destroy you, why would I waste so much time? Are you really dumb enough to think that your actions bear no consequences?

I hope you've seen and learned enough. The Junes. The Zem. They've made their choices. Who is to blame if the choice is wrong, except for themselves? Do you understand now? Perhaps, not everything is lost for you!

But that's enough. Let's see who wins the bet, shall we?
Find all Centaur the Traveler's notes on Ammer

Heavenly Eye insists her brother never planned to leave Ammer, but the call of adventure was too strong. He's either beyond the border, or his dead body rests somewhere on the green meadows of the Aoidoi land.

In either case, you should start looking for him around. He liked to keep record of his adventures. His notes might contain the necessary information.

Well, that's it... The traveler has found his way. It's time you found yours.

Who knows, you might find another mysterious note in your pocket some day...
Hear out the huntress in the Centaur Camp on Ammer.

Greetings, Stormbringer! My name is Heavenly Eye. I'm one of the hunters of the Spiral Ridge.

The tribe respects your strength and wisdom. All the moons of this world favor you. I understand that my problem is undeserving of such honor, but I hope that luck will be with me. After all, the Well won't swallow me for just one question.

My brother has gone missing. He went hunting two moons ago, and I haven't seen him since.

My heart is restless. I can feel it, something bad has happened! I have no one to turn to for help! I tried searching myself, but in vain.

Please, find me in the Centaur Camp on the Spiral Ridge if you think you can help me.

Have a swift ride,

Heavenly Eye.
May the winds be fair, Stormbringer! I didn't hope you would condescend to me.
This must be what Cosmos was talking about. It looks like you will have to work hard to find the other records.

The ink dried up and a new text appeared in their place, summarizing the discovered entries:

"The first four worlds became the source of materials for the creation of the rest of the worlds. The All-Mother and Father Time created the gods who were entrusted with the preservation and protection of these worlds. And each god had the same name as their world."
It won't be easy to understand the records. You should keep searching.

The last records magically changed again:

"These four worlds were created next. Each of them embodied the principle that ruled other worlds.

Subsequently, the power of Enod and Inis spread throughout the universe, and Sherk waged a relentless and fruitless war against them.

Only Ossu remained forgotten, and the power over the Darkness was not claimed by anyone. Eventually it had a new master, but that happened much later."
It's getting more and more interesting! Who knows where it's going?

Once again, the records were rewritten by a mysterious force:

"The last four inner worlds served as the pillars of the entire system of the universe.

From that moment, the Great Gods, the children of the All-Mother and Father Time, set out to create the worlds of the outer circle.

They were countless, and their appearance was infinitely diverse, but each of the new worlds carried particles of the original ones."
Find the last Echo of Power

Your inner voice tells you there is one element missing from the puzzle. Some kind of explanation that will help you understand the notes.

You need to find it.

Curious...

I should tell Cosmos about the records.

In the beginning of this eon, the universe was empty. The last eon ended with a terrible war that devastated the universe.

But there was a great Eidos, home of all the gods. It was the beginning of everything. Everything that had to be created originally existed in Eidos.

And although the gods were at enmity with each other, peace reigned in Eidos, maintained by the royal couple - Father Time and All-Mother. Infinitely wise and capable, they were determined to rebuild existence.

At the very beginning, twelve inner worlds were created...
Visit Semer Dinar at Yasker's Tower in Nezebgrad.

The advertising booklet abounds with colorful promises of untold wealth and flowery bureaucratese explaining how the Free Traders again are planning to benefit from other people's endeavor.

Anyway, it is something worth taking a look at! I should stop by that Negotiant and see what he offers.

Another addressee got interested? Very, very well. The customer base is growing!

Let me tell you more about the exchange.

Bring the hull upgrade module to the master shipbuilder in the hangar. Don't forget to disengage your ship beforehand!

The module instructions read as follows: "This model includes a set of tools and calculations that allow one to modify a ship's hull, creating additional portholes and new cannon mounts for top deck and aft side cannons. This new module also makes significant improvements to the hull's aesthetics.
Do not try to install this module yourself! Go visit a certified specialist, a master shipbuilder. The upgrades are made as quickly as possible (practically instantaneously) and will last throughout all subsequent hull model upgrades."

Aha! This is a truly unique prototype. There are but a few like them in our entire fleet! So you've lucked out. Shall we get to it, then?
To upgrade the hull, just select it for work in the hangar and speak to me.

Congratulations!
Now your ship's hull is a true marvel of engineering genius! You can now add cannons to the upper deck and, best of all, resolve the issue of enemy pursuit by installing some on the aft side.
Not to mention your new hull is much more attractive. There are only a handful of ships like yours in our entire fleet!
Collect your prize from the master shipbuilder in the hangar. If you still do not have an astral ship, build one.
This certificate allows the captain bearing it to receive equipment or decorations for their ship. You can choose your prize from the master shipbuilder in the hangar.

Hello. Are you looking for souvenirs, too? In that case, I must ask you for your certificate. And remember, the gift is available only if you have a ship. If not, you'll simply have to wait until you've had one built.

Let's see, everything's signed, the seal is in place... Good. You can choose from third-generation equipment or decorations.
The first prize is a set of modified third-gen equipment: cannons, shields, reactor, motor, and helm. These will allow you to explore the third layer and, with a little luck, even the fourth!
If your ship is already well-equipped or if you choose to decorate it first, then take two ship coupons and an excellent statue made by elven artisans.
This certificate allows the captain bearing it to choose from a selection of equipment or decorations for their ship. You can collect your prize from the master shipbuilder in the hangar.

Interesting... According to this document, you can choose third-generation equipment or decorations for your ship.
The first prize is a set of modified third-generation equipment: cannons, shields, reactor, motor, and helm. These will allow you to explore the third layer or even the fourth, although that will be more challenging.
If your ship is already well-equipped or if you choose to decorate it first, then take two ship coupons and an excellent statue made by elven artisans.
Bring 1 ship coupon and 2 platinum coins to the Ship Equipment Master.

Hey captain! We need to talk. We received a small lot of various elven ship decorations at the warehouse. Beauty's unspeakable! I would have bought everything myself, but I have no ship. But if you want, I can issue a permit to buy elven goods. For quite low prices! All it'll take is one Ship Coupon and a few platinum coins for customs duties. And your ship will glare like an elven galleon castle!
That's nice! Now you can switch to the ship remodeling mode and decorate your flagship like a royal castle!
Bring 3 Ship Coupons to Ship Device Master

Hey captain! Would you like to decorate your ship a bit? Then I've got a proposition for you!
Not long ago our strike squadron boarded a state-of-the-art Imperial corvette near the Imperial Archipelagos. The prototype is equipped with technological novelties made by the Arisen from stem to stern! The military immediately snatched all the guns, shields, and other equipment for themselves. They classified and disassembled it all. As for decorations taken off the captured ship - projectors, lamps and the like - they're just collecting dust in my warehouse.
For a purely symbolic price of three ship coupons, I'll issue you a permit to buy these trophy gadgets.
Great! You can now switch to ship customization mode and transform your ship into a flying mausoleum or a research lab!
Complete the astral island Metalville in the actual sector 10 times.
Kill all the prisoners and Miroslav Kramolsky.

Look who's here! Wait, wasn't it you who put me to prison? No? Ah, whatever.
We've got a riot here, so I'm off. If you want to stay, it's none of my business.
The White Knight, Miroslav Kramolsky was imprisoned here. His Imperial friends arrived and started shooting this and that, in order to free him and stir the League a bit.
What they didn't know, is that Kramolsky'd got tangled with the evil. Once he's broken free, he trapped everyone's soul in the prison. I was the only one to escape - my soul'd been captured by the gold long ago. So everyone else serves him now.
You know what? I've still got a business deal here. There are some guys who owe me money, and Kramolsky now possesses their souls. Will you kill them and free their Sparks? And then kill Kramolsky, too. Deal? I'll pay you gold!

What kind of brutes are you? Look, you've killed every single person in here! Now their Sparks are scattered all over the Astral! Where shall I find them, eh?
Oh, whatever, they'll come running as soon as they need more gold, anyway. I thought, may be I should stay here, now that the stronghold is vacant.
Here's your reward. Thanks for your aid.
Receive a present from Zinaida Krichalkina in Nezebgrad.

The bottom of an empty chest contains a greeting card:
"Dear hero! Your path was difficult and great are your accomplishments. Your glory will not fade for centuries! Your deeds are forever recorded into the history of Sarnaut, and for this anniversary we would like to present you with a gift, a rare glyph. You can select a glyph from the Holiday Committee Official, Zinaida Krichalkina.
We congratulate you on this celebration and wish you all the best!"
Receive a present from Valya Skomorokhova in Novograd.

You can select a glyph from the Holiday Committee Official, Valya Skomorokhova.
We congratulate you on this celebration and wish you all the best!"

I have bad news, Keeper. Demon Prowlers are on the allod. These monsters have an infallible gut when it comes to sensing magic... Anyway, it doesn't matter.

The prowlers can find the source way faster than we can, as crazy as it may sound. Our only chance to beat them is to use their own instinct... Killing them all would also buy us some time!

We'll study their memory as well... and that's not all I can do!

It's... an egg.

It can't be real! Is it truly the Great Dragon's egg? Or is there something never-seen-before inside? Where has the egg come from? How could the Great Mages of Sarnaut miss it?

All this is very disturbing, Keeper.

What's even more disturbing, is the fact that the hostile bunch of demons is aware of it now. If they are even guessing what treasure is in your hands... We will have to deal with a full-scale invasion soon.
Examine Astral emanations over the allod.

Before we find the source, we must study the consequences of your allod's expansion. Did you notice the shining clots of Astral emanations over your allod last night?.. I find them very interesting!

Try studying them yourself. Pegasus will help you reach them.
Are you done? I can't wait to start the research.

Well, I would recognize this magic signature anywhere... Keeper, these emanations are not Astral-related.

On the contrary. They were produced by the Great Dragon.

Do you understand what this means? Demons believe that the Dragon hides on your allod. Not Dragon's Spark, like on the Frozen Frontier. Not its remnants, either. Your allod is very young, there's no way it could have such things.

But how could this happen?..
Discover and destroy spies that got onto your allod under the cover of darkness.

I'm sorry, Keeper, but your arrival to our lands was noticed. My people report spotting suspicious strangers in the night. They definitely came from somewhere else. I'm afraid, Tritogor hired spies to sabotage things here.

Creating a full-scale militia will take time, and the spies have to go right now!
Tritogor's grip is strong... Even in the Empire, he has strings to pull at any time. Fortunately, everything worked out well, thanks to your help!

I heard about your alliance with the demons, Keeper. Many would consider your decision crazy... but I can see a potential.

Not all demons are eager to meet you halfway. My agents report spotting hostile demons at the allod's borders. One of them, a demon sorcerer of considerable might, blatantly interfered into your allod's magosphere. It is an ephemeral shell, which helps the Great Mage deter... However, I don't think it's something you care about now.

You should take into account, though, that such interference may affect the life on the allod. Astral streams brought me the name of this demon. It's Nimross.

We must repel him.

Demons took interest in the allod's growth, too. Nimross is trying to look into the nature of this phenomenon... pretty smart for a demon! Something is telling me it's not the last time we hear about him.

Frankly, I don't think he died. There's something unusual about his Astral nature. I can still feel his mental presence.
Discover and destroy spies that got onto your allod under the cover of darkness.

Tritogor's grip is solid. Even Aidenus's personal guards got under his influence. Fortunately, everything is fine thanks to you.
Go upstairs to the hall of your private allod.
I had no idea goblins could build such a nice castle. I wonder who designed it.
Have you visited the hall yet?

It's very spacious. New curtains would be nice, but it's okay.

I'll be right here if you don't mind, Keeper.
Interrogate the prisoner and find out about their objectives.
I must admit, your combat skills... surprised me. My people arrested one of the scouts. He is imprisoned in your catacombs now. I thought you might want to question him personally.

Your allod is expanding, he says? Is that all they care about? It means I was mistaken. They're not Tritogor's minions. How could he let me go just like that?

Nevertheless, this information is important. Such anomalies don't appear all by themselves. What are the limits of its growth? Will the land that appears be fit for life? I have so many questions... Pardon my scientific interest.

Interrogate the prisoner and find out about their objectives.
I must admit, your combat skills... surprised me. My people arrested one of the scouts. He is imprisoned in your catacombs now. I thought you might want to question him personally.

Your allod is expanding, he says? Is that all they care about? It means I was mistaken. They're not Tritogor's minions. How could he let me go just like that?

The portal that Nimross supported was probably used not only for teleportation, but also for communicating with his lord. We could use it before it fades. It's pretty easy if you know how. The demonic magic is rather primitive.

Keeper, I can teach you magic decryption so you can use this portal.

What we managed to find out is that the source of expansion is evidently somewhere around... It is a physical object, not an ephemeral substance, as it often happens when it comes to Astral magic.

Examine Astral emanations over the allod.

Before we find the source, we must study the consequences of your allod's expansion. Did you notice the shining clots of Astral emanations over your allod last night?.. I find them very interesting!

Try studying them yourself. Pegasus will help you reach them.
Are you done? I can't wait to start the research.

Well, I would recognize this magic signature anywhere... Keeper, these emanations are not Astral-related.

On the contrary. They were produced by the Great Dragon.

Do you understand what this means? Demons believe that the Dragon hides on your allod. Not Dragon's Spark, like on the Frozen Frontier. Not its remnants, either. Your allod is very young, there's no way it could have such things.

But how could this happen?..

I have bad news, Keeper. Demon Prowlers are on the allod. These monsters have an infallible gut when it comes to sensing magic... Anyway, it doesn't matter.

The prowlers can find the source way faster than we can, as crazy as it may sound. Our only chance to beat them is to use their own instinct... Killing them all would also buy us some time!

We'll study their memory as well... and that's not all I can do!

It's... an egg.

It can't be real! Is it truly the Great Dragon's egg? Or is there something never-seen-before inside? Where has the egg come from? How could the Great Mages of Sarnaut miss it?

All this is very disturbing, Keeper.

What's even more disturbing, is the fact that the hostile bunch of demons is aware of it now. If they are even guessing what treasure is in your hands... We will have to deal with a full-scale invasion soon.
Defend your private allod from demonic invasion.

Keeper! There's a demonic army at our gates. The walls are standing, but our only hope is to strike back before the fortress collapses!

I took the liberty of calling the reinforcements. Mercenary leader, my old friend Alexander Kuzmin, will arrive together with his team. Talk to him if you need help.

Good luck, Keeper. I hope to see you after the battle.
Got to hurry! Talk to you later!

Victory! The victory is ours, Keeper.

The demons confirmed our guess. So it really is the Dragon... It's amazing.

I have no clue how it got here, other than by our own ships. I also have no idea how it got on board. Who brought it to the allod from the ship? Was this someone's idea, or is the egg capable of... guising itself?

What else can it do? I know nothing about the Great Dragons... How fast do they grow? What do they eat? What does it portend for us all?

Oh... Well, it was a long day. I will study it tomorrow. In the meantime, it's time to have rest. Fighting together with you is an honor, Keeper.

However, I don't think it's something you care about now.

You should take into account, though, that such interference may affect the life on the allod. Astral streams brought me the name of this demon. It's Nimross.

We must repel him.

Demons took interest in the allod's growth, too. Nimross is trying to look into the nature of this phenomenon... pretty smart for a demon! Something is telling me it's not the last time we hear about him.
